text:
mira: ok team, quick kickoff for the upcoming external pentest. goal: minimal blast radius, clear evidence paths, and a single retest window.
sam: +1. what's our proposed retest window?
tara: prefer a 3hr window during US morning (10-13 PT) so EU overlap is minimal.
mira: thinking Tue 2026-05-12 10:00-13:00 PT. can we lock infra changes freeze 24h before?
sam: yes — freeze from Mon 10:00 PT. we'll toggle autoscale to static and note it in runbook.
joe: question on access: are we giving read-only S3 + CloudWatch logs, or do we need ephemeral assume-role for some services?
mira: assessor will get ephemeral AWS role via STS. no long-lived creds. we'll provide presigned S3 links for large artifacts to avoid wide S3 list perms.
joe: ok. how are we packaging audit logs? need clear timestamps + request IDs for repro.
tara: we'll export CloudWatch -> S3 with a single prefix: s3://redwood-pt-logs/<eng-sec-thread>/ and include a manifest. retention 90 days.
mira: include KV cache traces and serving runtime logs for the affected model versions. also snapshot KMS key metadata (not private key material).
sam: about KMS: we need to confirm assessor can't call Decrypt. only GetPublicKey / DescribeKey (where applicable). can we create a policy that denies decrypt operations for the ephemeral role?
joe: yes, create an IAM policy like: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
mira: perfect. also need to confirm audit logging captures STS assume-role events and API Gateway request IDs.
tara: I'll add checks in the preflight checklist. link to checklist: https://redwood-internal/pt/checks/7390012345
pentest-bot: new ticket PT-8421 created, severity scan scheduled.
mira: remediation tracking: we'll use PT-8421 as parent. each fix gets a child ticket in the vuln queue with CVSS and remediation ETA. share a CSV snapshot 24h before retest.
sam: for RBAC changes during remediation, put a feature flag and a revert button. no permanent broad perms.
joe: during the retest, we should have an on-call observer in the channel to triage noisy false positives. tara you okay to be primary?
tara: I can cover 10:00-12:00 PT. mira will span 12:00-13:00 PT handoff.
mira: evidence handoff process: presigned manifests + a signed SHA256 file for each bundle. include a small sample of full request/response bodies (sanitized).
joe: can we add a quick log export command to the runbook?
sam: yes: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-logs/7390012345/serve_logs.tgz ./ --region us-west-2
sha256sum serve_logs.tgz > serve_logs.tgz.sha256
```
mira: good. last item: retest acceptance criteria. if a finding is marked fixed in staging and verified by assessor in retest, we close the child ticket and record regression score 0/5. if partial, we keep open with notes + temporary mitigation.
tara: will draft the acceptance rubric and share by EOD.
joe: anything blocking approvals from legal/compliance?
mira: compliance needs a short statement about data handled by assessor (no PII). I'll ping compliance for sign-off.
tara: I'll create a short compliance blurb: https://redwood-internal/pt/compliance/7390012345-draft
sam: thanks. I'll schedule the infra freeze and create the ephemeral role with deny-decrypt policy.
mira: thanks team — I'll circulate final checklist and the evidence prefix by Friday. :thumbsup:
